hints: It equals the maximum difference in either x+y or x-y.
Maintain the minimum and maximum of both transformed coordinates as points arrive.
analogy: Two diagonal rulers replace separate horizontal and vertical measurements.
example: For (0,0) and (2,-1), x-y differs by 3, so their Manhattan distance is 3.
algorithm: For each new point update the minimum and maximum of x+y and x-y. Print the larger of their two ranges; with one point both ranges are zero. Use wide integers.
correctness: For every pair, |dx|+|dy| equals max(|dx+dy|,|dx-dy|). The greatest absolute difference among transformed values is their maximum minus minimum, so the larger range is the desired diameter.
complexity: For n points, O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
